versions.content: If the API PduR_SomeIpTpCopyRxData()returns some- thing else than BUFREQ_OK, • The assembly process for this PDU ID shall be interrupted as defined by SWS_ SomeIpTp_00054. • . • The API Det_ReportRuntimeError() shall be called with the runtime error code SOMEIPTP_E_ASSEMBLY_INTERRUPT.
